courses.title: Computer-Based Info Systems
learningOutcomes: Manage and leverage data effectively through modern database systems
Transform raw data into strategic business intelligence using industry-standard tools
Automate business processes and harness the power of programming for real-world problem solving
Protect information assets in an increasingly digital world

courses.title: Introduction to Programming
learningOutcomes: Apply fundamental programming syntax and constructs
Design and implement structured applications
Translate written problem description plans and business requirements into working programs
Use an integrated development environment
Utilize cloud-based version control tools

courses.title: Business Programming Languages
learningOutcomes: Apply object-oriented programming principles to develop event-driven software applications.
Apply software architectural patterns and design principles to develop maintainable, modular, and scalable applications.
Design and implement data persistence solutions through relational databases and modern data access technologies.
Develop and integrate application programming interfaces (APIs), external services, and other data sources to enable communication between software systems.
Develop a comprehensive software application that integrates user interface design, data management, software architecture, and system integration to solve a real-world business problem.

courses.title: Business Data Analysis
learningOutcomes: Able to demonstrate strategic utilization of programming, data, and analytics skills to address complex business challenges and enhance decision-making processes.
Able to utilize Python's data structures, control structures, and functions to solve complex business problems.
Able to exhibit skills in data visualization to conduct meaningful business analyses and provide actionable insights.
Able to apply debugging techniques with generative AI tools such as ChatGPT to identify and fix errors in analytics programming.
Able to apply effective team collaboration skills, working within diverse groups to perform in-depth data analyses and make informed decisions.

courses.title: Databases
learningOutcomes: Extract and analyze data using SQL
Design and model relational databases
Apply normalization and implement databases
Compare and utilize advanced data management systems
Integrate database knowledge for business decision-making

courses.title: Systems Analysis and Design Theory
learningOutcomes: Explain and apply the phases of the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Utilize various methods to gather system requirements
Model data and processes using structured and object-oriented techniques
Evaluate alternative system solutions based on feasibility and risk
Develop and present a comprehensive system design proposal as part of a team project

courses.title: Electronic Business
learningOutcomes: Understand SAP basics and ERP concepts from a functional, technical and implementation perspective with an emphasis on the process-centered organization
Learn Salesforce basics and CRM concepts to understand cross-functional business operations (object management, workflow automation, etc.) via the integrated cloud system.
Gain hands-on experience through labs covering essential SAP operations, Salesforce tools, and related applications.
Develop critical thinking skills by solving real-world business problems using SAP and Salesforce.
Explore industry resources to help prepare for future SAP and Salesforce certifications.

courses.title: E-Commerce Web Design
learningOutcomes: Design and implement responsive front-end web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
Develop dynamic server-side applications and RESTful APIs using the MVC architecture.
Evaluate and implement hosting and deployment solutions for web applications.
Compare traditional coding platforms with low-code tools for web development use cases.
Construct a comprehensive web development project that demonstrates front-end, back-end, and hosting skills to address a real-world scenario.

courses.title: Business Infrastructure and Cyber Security
learningOutcomes: Explain how networks such as the Internet move messages from one computer to another through the hardware and software components
Design a network infrastructure (at a novice-level) using a variety of LAN, backbone, and WAN technologies and components
Recognize the major decisions needed in managing network infrastructure in organizations (e.g., network security) and understand which options are likely to lead to better performance
Identify components of cybersecurity relevant to any industry

courses.title: Project Management
learningOutcomes: Understands the best practices for project planning, execution, monitoring and closing.
Demonstrates knowledge of fundamental project management terms and techniques.
Develop skills identifying, communicating, and achieving defined business objectives.
Enhance teamwork and communication skills essential for working in a project environment.
Apply project management tools and techniques to a real-world scenario.

courses.title: Intelligent Robotic Automation
learningOutcomes: Develop bots for business tasks
Develop AI agents
Understand what tasks to automate and how to maintain AI agents
Deliver AI solutions to business needs

courses.title: Bitcoin & Blockchain
learningOutcomes: Grasp Bitcoin and Blockchain Essentials
Understand Economic, Legal, and Ethical Landscapes of Bitcoin
